spanish: Y si cabra *es* su ofrenda, y la acercará delante de Jehová.
grammarChanges: Supplied the missing copula for the verbless clause עֵז קָרְבָּנוֹ, written in italics as *es*.
Kept la unchanged: its Spanish antecedents cabra/ofrenda are grammatically feminine in Spanish, independent of the Hebrew masculine 3ms suffix on the verb.
readerNote: Supplied the copula *es* for the verbless clause and kept la because its Spanish antecedent (cabra/ofrenda) is grammatically feminine regardless of the Hebrew masculine suffix on the verb.
